page.title: Maps Manager
page.subtitle: Manage your stored map files and explore new regions!
page.baseAssetsMissing: The base map assets have not been installed. Please download them first to enable map functionality.
page.worldBasemapMissingMessage: The low-zoom world base map (~15 MB) hasn't been downloaded yet, so the map appears blank outside any regions you've downloaded. Connect this NOMAD to the internet and download it once for offline use.
page.globalInstalledMessage: Your global map build {{date}} ({{size}}) is stored locally and ready for offline use.
page.globalAvailableMessage: Download a complete worldwide map from Protomaps ({{size}}, build {{date}}). This is a large file but covers the entire planet — no individual region downloads needed.
page.countryAlertMessage: Pick the countries you actually need — from a single country to a whole continent — and we'll pull just those tiles from the global Protomaps archive. Much smaller than the full 125 GB global map.

confirmDelete.title: Confirm Delete?
confirmDelete.message: Are you sure you want to delete {{name}}? This action cannot be undone.

confirmDownload.title: Confirm Download?
confirmDownload.message: Are you sure you want to download {{name}}? It may take some time for it to be available depending on the file size and your internet connection.

confirmGlobal.title: Download Global Map?
confirmGlobal.message: This will download the full Protomaps global map ({{size}}, build {{date}}). Covers the entire planet so you won't need individual region files. Make sure you have enough disk space.

notifications.baseMapFailed: Could not download the base map. Please connect this NOMAD to the internet and try again.
notifications.globalQueued: Global map download has been queued. This is a large file (~125 GB) and may take a while.
notifications.globalFailed: Failed to start the global map download. Please try again.
notifications.baseAssetsFailed: An error occurred while downloading the base map assets. Please try again.
notifications.baseAssetsUnknown: An unknown error occurred while downloading base assets.
notifications.collectionQueued: Download for collection "{{name}}" has been queued.
notifications.collectionAlreadyInstalled: All resources in the collection "{{name}}" have already been downloaded.
notifications.fileDeleteFailed: Failed to delete {{name}}. Please try again.

downloadUrl.description: Enter the URL of the map region file you wish to download. The URL must be publicly reachable and end with .pmtiles. A preflight check will be run to verify the file's availability, type, and approximate size.
downloadUrl.unknownError: An unknown error occurred during the preflight check.
downloadUrl.passed: Preflight check passed. Filename: {{filename}}, Size: {{size}} MB

countryPicker.title: Download map by country or region
countryPicker.installedTitle: Already downloaded — re-select to update with a different zoom
countryPicker.zoomHint: Lower zoom = smaller file, less detail. Zoom 15 shows individual streets; zoom 10 shows city-level detail.
countryPicker.pickAtLeastOne: Pick at least one country before downloading.
countryPicker.stillEstimating: Still estimating size — hold on a moment.
countryPicker.pickToEstimate: Pick at least one country to estimate size.
